text: The government should protect the health of all citizens in your country. To what extent do you
agree with this view? [30]
Space travel and exploration should be managed by private companies rather than governments.
Discuss this view. [30]
Books inspire the minds of children. To what extent do you agree with this claim? [30]
Designers should always ensure that what they create is visually attractive. To what extent do you
agree with this statement? [30]
Spending on foreign aid should be a priority for wealthy countries. Discuss. [30]
To what extent is it desirable for all people in your country to earn the same amount of money?[30]
Ageing populations bring many benefits to society. To what extent do you agree? [30]
To what extent should environmental impacts influence what people choose to wear? [30]
It is unacceptable to monitor people using information obtained from their mobile devices.
Discuss. [30]
Any media with disturbing content should always begin with a clear warning for viewers.
Discuss. [30]
